name: Stock indicator
summary: Availability with a colored dot. The text carries the meaning.
use: Product page, Product card (when low or sold out), Add to cart.
avoid: Delivery time: put it on its own line (see Add to cart).
reactProps: Your own text, for example "Only 3 left".
a11y: Color is never the only signal: the text says the status.
dont: Only a colored dot without text.
